# Free Gun Sounds - 8 Game Sound Effects, Free

8 sound effects, free for commercial and non-commercial work with no
attribution required. These are the shipped files at the shipped levels, copied
out of a paid pack rather than made separately - the product, just less of it.

| File | Length |
| --- | --- |
| assault-rifle-shot-1.wav | 1.2s |
| pistol-dry-fire.wav | 0.5s |
| rifle-mag-insert.wav | 0.8s |
| shell-casing-concrete-1.wav | 0.8s |
| impact-concrete-1.wav | 0.8s |
| ricochet-1.wav | 1.2s |
| weapon-jam.wav | 0.9s |
| low-ammo-click.wav | 0.6s |

Total runtime 7s. Uncompressed WAV, 44.1 kHz 16-bit stereo,
1.1 MB. Every file measures below -0.3 dB true peak after a game
engine import re-encode, so nothing clips on the way in.

## Did these work for you?

A rating takes about ten seconds and is the single most useful thing you can do
for a small pack like this - it is what decides whether anyone else ever finds
it.

https://moneywithjjcom.itch.io/free-guns-sounds/rate

## Licence

Royalty-free for commercial and non-commercial work, including games and video
you sell. Unlimited projects, no attribution required, no expiry. Paid client
work is fine, and you may commit these files to a public source repository as
part of your project. You may not resell or redistribute the audio files on
their own, or include them in another sound library or pack.

## How these were made

Audio generated with ElevenLabs Sound Effects under a paid commercial
subscription, then screened, level-matched and edited by hand.
